rules.description: All currency codes must follow ISO 4217 standard
rules.validation: Currency matches /^[A-Z]{3}$/ AND is valid ISO 4217 code
rules.errorMessage: Invalid currency code in amount field.
rules.fix: Use valid ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, INR).

rules.description: Settlement Method is restricted in CBPR+ SR2026
rules.fix: Use valid CBPR+ settlement method: CLRG / INDA / INGA.

rules.validation: UETR not already used in system
rules.fix: Generate a new UUID v4 for UETR.

rules.description: Amount must not exceed 2 decimal places
rules.errorMessage: Amount must have max 2 decimal places.
rules.fix: Round or format amount to 2 decimals.

rules.description: BIC must be valid SWIFT format (8 or 11 chars)
rules.fix: Use valid 8 or 11 character SWIFT BIC.

rules.description: NbOfTxs must match actual transaction count
rules.errorMessage: NbOfTxs does not match actual transactions.
rules.fix: Set NbOfTxs equal to number of CdtTrfTxInf blocks.

rules.description: Message must use UTF-8 encoding only
